name: Picular
summary: Color generator that turns any word into a palette of matching hex colors drawn from image search.
description: The site describes itself as a fast primary-color generator built on Google image search: type a search term and it returns colors for it, with the headline "The color of anything." The search UI is rendered client-side, so only the title, description and heading are readable.
contains: color search: type a word, get matching colors
